multi_entity_note: Terms among element 5 GmbH, Affiliates and Software Publishers (multiple party roles).
processing_note: The payment can be made by wire transfer, Direct Deposit (US only) or check, as chosen by the Affiliate.

contract.document_name.value: Affiliate Program / Premium Affiliate Management General Terms and Conditions
contract.document_name.rationale: The heading gives the full title; later self-references use only the short form General Terms and Conditions.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The terms are a standard form with no date of agreement; 12/2/2005 is the SEC filing date in the page footer.

contract.effective_date.value: upon acceptance of Affiliate's Program application
contract.effective_date.rationale: Section IV §7 states the term begins upon acceptance of the Affiliate's Program application (an event, not a calendar date); 12/2/2005 is the filing footer.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement is entered into for an unlimited period, so there is no expiration date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: IV §9(4) states the law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies; other Germany mentions are the address and place of jurisdiction.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement is for an unlimited period with no renewal terms; listed durations are cookie lifespan, objection and payment-retention periods.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal and hence no notice period to prevent renewal; either party may cancel at any time.
